news.title: BlackRock Cuts IBIT In-Kind Conversion Minimum To $1M
news.body: BlackRock has reduced the in-kind conversion minimum for its iShares Bitcoin Trust from $25 million to $1 million, potentially making the mechanism available to a wider group of institutional participants.

news.title: BTCPay Backers Offer Bitcoin Bounty After Wallet Exploit
news.body: The reward aims to recover Bitcoin stolen after attackers gained access to connected LND wallets.
